dct_title_s: Zuidoostkust Celebes : Vaarwaters nabij Boeton en Moena. Noordblad
dct_description_sm: Hr. Ms. Opnemingsvaartuigen "Bali" 1900 en "Sumbawa" 1914-1917 ; U. S. Navy Hydrographic Office Emergency Reproduction of Netherlands Chart.
Depths shown by soundings; relief by hachures and spot heights.
Shows depths, low water areas, reefs, drainage, peaks.
